Tampa Bay Visitors Bureau

Attractions

Attractions

Beaches, museums & more

Five distinct beaches, a museum for every curiosity, and enough water, sport and stage time to fill a week.

The beaches

Beach

Clearwater Beach

Wide sugar-white sand, a nightly sunset celebration at Pier 60, and dolphin cruises leaving from the marina.

Beach

St. Pete Beach

Classic Gulf shoreline with historic beachfront hotels, parasailing and calm, swimmable water.

Beach · Park

Fort De Soto Park

A county park of five connected islands: award-winning beaches, a historic fort, kayak trails and a dog beach.

Beach · Island

Caladesi Island

Reach this undeveloped island by ferry from Honeymoon Island for quiet sand, shells and a mangrove kayak trail.

Beach · Island

Honeymoon Island

A state park close to Dunedin with nature trails, an osprey population and the ferry dock for Caladesi.

On the water

Boats, boards & fishing

Sunset cruises and dolphin tours from the downtown marina, fishing charters into the bay and Gulf, plus kayak and paddleboard rentals on the Hillsborough River.

Museums & landmarks

Museum

Tampa Museum of Art

Modern and contemporary art on the Riverwalk in downtown, with a riverfront terrace and café.

Museum · Science

MOSI

The Museum of Science & Industry: hands-on exhibits, a planetarium and an IMAX Dome theatre.

Museum · Kids

Glazer Children's Museum

Play-based exhibits downtown where kids can pilot a plane, run a vet clinic and build a city.

Museum · Historic

Henry B. Plant Museum

Inside the 1891 Tampa Bay Hotel at the University of Tampa — Victorian rooms beneath the famous silver minarets.

Museum · History

Tampa Bay History Center

Three floors of regional history on the Riverwalk, from the first Floridians to the cigar era, with a Columbia Café.

Museum · St. Pete

The Dalí & Chihuly

Across the bay in St. Petersburg: the Dalí Museum's surrealist collection and the Chihuly Collection's glass art.

Animals

ZooTampa at Lowry Park

A 63-acre zoo known for Florida wildlife, giraffe feeding and one of the nation's top manatee care centers.

Animals · Free

TECO Manatee Viewing Center

In Apollo Beach, manatees gather in the warm water by the power station in cooler months. Seasonal and free.

Water park

Adventure Island

Tampa's big water park across from Busch Gardens — slides, a lazy river and a wave pool for hot afternoons.

Districts, sports & stages

District

Ybor City & Columbia Restaurant

The historic cigar district: brick streets, hand-rolled cigar shops and lunch at the Columbia, Florida's oldest restaurant (founded 1905).

Downtown

Riverwalk, Armature Works & Sparkman Wharf

A 2.6-mile riverfront path linking museums and parks, with food halls at Armature Works (Heights) and Sparkman Wharf (Channel District).

Sports

Game day: Rays, Bucs & Lightning

Baseball with the Rays, football with the Buccaneers at Raymond James Stadium, hockey with the Lightning — ask about stadium tours on non-game days.

Performing arts

Straz Center & Tampa Theatre

Broadway tours and opera at the Straz Center on the river; classic films and concerts inside the 1926 Tampa Theatre movie palace.

Craft drinks

Breweries & distilleries

Start with Cigar City Brewing, the brewery that put Tampa beer on the map, then follow the local craft trail through Ybor and Seminole Heights.

Campus landmark

Plant Hall & USF Botanical Gardens

Visit the University of Tampa's Plant Hall for its minarets and museum, and stroll the University of South Florida's botanical garden — landmarks to see, right in the city.

Free things to do

  • Walk or cycle the Tampa Riverwalk
  • TECO Manatee Viewing Center (seasonal)
  • Ride the TECO Streetcar — it's fare-free
  • Sunset at Pier 60, Clearwater Beach
  • Ybor City Saturday Market browsing
  • Bayshore Boulevard, the world's longest continuous sidewalk

Rainy-day saves

  • Florida Aquarium and Tampa Bay History Center
  • MOSI exhibits, planetarium and IMAX
  • Glazer Children's Museum for younger kids
  • Tampa Theatre matinee under its indoor "night sky"
  • International Plaza and Westshore Plaza malls

Kid-friendly & pet-friendly

  • Kids: Glazer Children's Museum, ZooTampa, Busch Gardens, the aquarium
  • Dog beach and trails at Fort De Soto Park
  • Dog-friendly patios at Sparkman Wharf and Armature Works
  • Golf, spas and photo spots: courses across the bay area, hotel spas in downtown and Hyde Park, and photo favorites at Plant Hall, the Riverwalk and Ybor's murals

Start with one idea. Leave with a full itinerary.
